title: Rental Desk Guidance: Extensions and the End of a Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Rental
content:
## When a rental ends

A rental under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement ends on whichever of the following comes first:

1. the option's repair-complete grace days after the shop reports repairs complete;
2. the option's total-loss end days after the total-loss settlement is offered;
3. the option's denial end days after a coverage denial is communicated;
4. the day the per-loss maximum or the maximum days are used up;
5. the day the customer returns the car;
6. the day before the at-fault party's insurer takes over the rental, which is recorded as a liability transfer.

Days after the end are the customer's.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical dates and day counts)

Assume an option with 1 repair-complete grace day.

- The shop reports repairs complete on April 8, and the customer keeps the car. The rental ends on April 9. April 10 and any later day are the customer's.
- On the same facts, the customer returns the car on April 8. The rental ends on April 8, because the return comes first.
- The other driver's insurer accepts liability and takes over the rental from April 12. The rental under the option ends on April 11, and the transfer is recorded as a liability transfer.

## Extension clauses no longer in force

The following former extension clauses are **no longer in force**. They are kept here as retired text only, and the days an extension adds are now set under the current extension basis.

- *Retired:* an authorization is extended by the extension increment at a time, only when the shop confirms a new completion date or documents a parts delay, and never beyond the maximum days per loss in total or beyond what the per-loss maximum can still pay.
- *Retired:* an extension is granted only while the total days authorized on the claim stay within the maximum days per loss.

superseded_clauses: An authorization is extended by extension_increment_days at a time, only when the shop confirms a new completion date (extension_requires_shop_confirmation) or documents a parts delay (parts_delay_extension_allowed), and never beyond max_days_per_loss in total or beyond what the per-loss maximum can still pay.
An extension is granted only while the total days authorized on the claim stay within max_days_per_loss.
